Call centre and IP telephony linked to your CRM

Every call reaches a free operator and lands in the CRM with its recording, missed calls get a call back, and the owner sees who answered. An MVP in 2–4 weeks, from UZS 30 mln; the full version in 6–10 weeks.

Estimate it for your business

Timeline
MVP 2–4 weeksFull 6–10 weeks

Who it is for
Restaurants and cafes, Clinics, Delivery services, Retail, Developers and real estate, Car services and dealers, Education centres and schools, Service businesses

What you get

What the MVP includes
  • Cloud PBX or Asterisk on a local SIP trunk
  • Your existing numbers or one short number
  • Voice menu in Uzbek and Russian
  • Queues and call distribution
  • Call recording with a recorded notice
  • Caller card and call log in amoCRM, Bitrix24 or your system
  • Missed-call list with call-back
What the full version adds
  • Several branches on one number
  • Operator screen for order entry into iiko, R-Keeper or 1C
  • Call tracking by ad source
  • Live supervisor board
  • Links to ai-call-quality and to ai-voice-agent for night hours
  • Reports per operator
Please note

Lines, numbers and minutes are paid to the telecom operator.

What we need from you

  • How the work runs today: who does what
  • Existing data: Excel, notebooks or an old system
  • 1–2 staff to try the system

Questions

What does “Call centre and IP telephony linked to your CRM” cost?
The MVP costs $2,500–6,000 (UZS 30–73 mln), the full version $8,000–20,000 (UZS 96–245 mln). The exact price depends on the integrations and the scope.
How long does “Call centre and IP telephony linked to your CRM” take?
The MVP takes 2–4 weeks, the full version 6–10 weeks.
What do we need to provide?
How the work runs today: who does what; Existing data: Excel, notebooks or an old system; 1–2 staff to try the system.
